#### `places_block` {#places_block}

<p class="fl-facts">required · block</p>

**The starting part of a multi-block structure.**

It has to be a block type that is genuinely a multi-block, AND the part it names has to be the FIRST part. Anything else is rejected when the file is read and the feature then fails every placement.

#### `enforce_placement_rules` {#enforce_placement_rules}

<p class="fl-facts">optional · boolean · absent: false</p>

**Asks the world to apply its own placement rules to the write.**

Off by default here, unlike single_block where the key is required.

#### `randomize_rotation` {#randomize_rotation}

<p class="fl-facts">optional · boolean · absent: false</p>

**Turns the structure a random quarter-turn before placing it.**

Requires the block to carry a cardinal-direction state; without one the flag is quietly dropped when the file is read.

#### `may_replace` {#may_replace}

<p class="fl-facts">optional · blockList</p>

**The blocks this feature is allowed to overwrite.**

An empty list, and an absent key, both mean NO constraint -- the feature overwrites whatever it lands on. Listing blocks narrows it; there is no way to spell "replace nothing" here.
